content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in the short term, showing a persistent lag.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with price rebounds, indicating bullish sentiment drives upward corrections.", "Model forecasts often overshoot during high volatility periods, leading to overcorrection.", "Price mean-reversion is evident when forecasts are too optimistic, triggering downward adjustments.", "Sentiment decay after peak bullish signals precedes price correction, suggesting sentiment is a leading indicator.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends, indicating sentiment validation.", "Models fail to capture extreme price drops when sentiment turns bearish, showing sensitivity to sentiment shifts.", "Forecast bias toward higher prices persists despite negative sentiment, indicating model overconfidence in upward bias."]}
